variables.meaning: 1 if launcher w is assigned to engage target t at firing time slot s; 0 otherwise
optional launcher initial orientation angle/vector used by RF/R strategies

equivalence_rules: Binary tuple assignment z_{t,w,s} is equivalent to theta_tws if all time, launcher, target and inventory constraints are preserved.
The PK model must depend on both relative distance and heading error unless the strategy/sample explicitly sets heading error to zero after rotation.
A simple target coverage model without firing slots, heading error and rotation/firing delay constraints is not equivalent.
forbidden_extensions: generic static weapon-target assignment without time slots
cost or threat objectives not in the source formulation
cluster coverage constraints replacing WTA constraints
omitting feasible firing slots or firing delay

derived.meaning: relative distance between launcher and target predicted intercept point
heading error between launcher orientation and PIP heading

derived.meaning: probability of kill affected by distance and heading error

derived.formula: required rotation angle between successive heading vectors divided by v_rot
derived.meaning: rotation time between successive engagements under R strategy
expected kill probability for target t under assigned launcher-time slots

objective.meaning: maximize total expected PK / engagement success over targets

constraints.formula: sum_t theta_tws <= 1 for all launcher w and slot s
constraints.meaning: a launcher can engage at most one target at a time slot

constraints.formula: sum_w sum_s theta_tws <= n_as_t for each target t
sum_t sum_s theta_tws <= n_st_w for each launcher w
theta_t1,w,s1 * theta_t2,w,s2 = 0 for conflicting slots |s1-s2| <= tau_d with different firings
constraints.meaning: minimum firing delay between successive launcher firings

constraints.meaning: assignment only at feasible firing time slots

constraints.meaning: maximum allowable rotation angle from initial orientation

strategy_policy.RF_strategy: orientation angles are fixed; use heading-error PK and RF constraints C1-C5/C8
strategy_policy.R_strategy: launcher can rotate to improve heading-error PK but must satisfy rotation/realignment and maximum-angle constraints C6_R-C7_R
strategy_policy.clustering_initialization: source-supported method for choosing initial launcher orientations; not a separate optimization constraint unless the public stress sample explicitly asks for initialization design
